description: 64x 400G QSFP-DD and 2x 10G SFP+ 2RU data-centre switch running NX-OS. The port side carries the QSFP-DD cages in sixteen columns of stacked pairs in an upper and a lower group, the stacked SFP+ pair, the console, an RJ-45 and an SFP management port, the USB port and the BCN, STS and ENV lamps. The other side carries four fan modules and two power supplies stacked at the right. Ports number 1-64 in pairs down each column, odd on the upper cage. Ships port-side intake only (burgundy modules).

gaps.note: The Switch Dimensions table (PDF p60, printed 54) gives the depth as 29.82 in (75.76 cm) and the width as 17.41 in (44.23 cm); the Clearance Requirements table (printed p10) gives the depth of the chassis as 29.78 in (75.65 cm) and the chassis width as 17.3 in (43.9 cm). The Dimensions table is carried, 442.3 by 757.6 mm, because its row also carries the height and the RU; the 4 mm of depth and 3 mm of width are not explained by the guide.
gaps.wanted: Which inclusion each figure has (whether 29.78 in is the chassis without a module handle).

gaps.note: The guide names two rack kits, NXK-ACC-KIT2-2RU and N9K-C9300-RMK ("Installation Options with Rack-Mount Kits", printed p17), and gives the install procedure for NXK-ACC-KIT2-2RU only (printed p21); no ear position is drawn or dimensioned.
gaps.wanted: The shipped ear position, if the chassis has ears, and what N9K-C9300-RMK holds. The guide's "Installing the Chassis in a Four-Post Rack" table lists "Rack-mount brackets (2)", "Rack-mount guides (2)", "Rack-mount guide rails (2)" and screws without naming the kit it belongs to.

gaps.note: Appendix D lists the NXK-ACC-KIT2-2RU as a slider bracket (2), slider rails (2) and twelve M4 screws, with a ground lug kit; the install procedure calls its parts inner rails and outer rails. cisco/nxk-acc-kit2-2ru@1 is the procedure's wording and is referenced, not edited.

The weights row (PDF p60, printed 54) names a 3000-W AC/HVDC port-side intake supply (NXA-PAC-3000W-PI) and the power-specifications contents name a 3000-W AC supply (for PSU3KW-HVPI). The Overview's user-replaceable components list names the two 3200 W supplies only, and the Table 1 rows name the 3200 W supplies only. The 3000 W supply is not seated and no component is added; cisco/n9k-pac-3000w-b@1 is the Nexus 9500's different part and is not used.
gaps.wanted: Whether NXA-PAC-3000W-PI is orderable for this chassis, and its face.

gaps.note: "Unpacking and Inspecting a New Switch" (printed p18) lists a 3000 W dual AC/DC supply (PSU3KW-HVPI), a 2000 W AC/DC supply (PSU-2KW-ACPI) and a 1400 W AC supply (PSU-1.4KW-ACPI) with red or blue tabs. They are not in the Overview and no other page names them; the text is read as left over from another switch's guide and is not carried.

The Overview prints NXA-SFAN-160CFM2-PI, the weights row NXA-FAN-160CFM2-PI, Table 1 "NXA-SF AN-160CFM2PI", and the label on the rear figure (art 503685) a label of the "NXA-FAN-160CFM2PI" form that the figure is too small to read letter by letter. The component is cisco/nxa-sfan-160cfm2@1, named by the Overview's and the Dimensions appendix's form.
gaps.wanted: The printed label at full size, and whether NXA-FAN-160CFM2 is a second part.

gaps.note: Appendix C describes the fan status lamp and the power-supply lamps by state and not by position; the figure draws a ring on each fan and two circles with a small mark on each supply.
gaps.wanted: Which circle is which, and what the small mark between them is.

gaps.note: The figure draws two small circles above the management SFP cage under printed text, two circles between the boxed triangles under each lower-group column, one lamp under the SFP+ pair, printed marks beside it and perforation fields. None is named by the guide's Switch Chassis LEDs table or its callout table; they are drawn as marks, and the SFP+ marks are not drawn.
gaps.wanted: What those marks are, and the printed numerals under the SFP+ pair.

gaps.note: Appendix C says every port has a lamp. The figure draws lamps under the lower group only and no lamp near the upper group's cages.
gaps.wanted: Where the upper group's lamps are.

A picture of the 3200 W DC/HVDC supply. The guide's figure shows AC supplies only ("AC power supplies shown"). Its face is the AC supply's with the inlet changed, and the guide's lug (a two-hole copper lug, #2 AWG) is not drawn.
A stated size for the supplies and the fan module. The guide gives neither.

A flat drawing of the lid, the underside and the two side walls. The guide's only picture of a side (PDF page 9, art 503686, "The figure shows the side of the chassis", with one callout, "Grounding pad") is a three-quarter view from the front left that shows a side wall, the lid with a rectangular cover plate and the grounding pad; it is perspective, so nothing on a wall can be measured from it, and no wall is drawn. The grounding pad is left out of the rear for the same reason.

gaps.note: "Replacing a Fan Module During Operations" (printed p37): "there must be three fan modules circulating air in the chassis at all times. The other fan module is redundant", and the Overview note says that if one fan fails the others go to 100%, and if two fail "the switch will issue a warning, and power down in 2 minutes".
gaps.wanted: Nothing further: read as modules, three of four, so the group says 3+1.

attrs.redundancy-note: installation guide: four fan modules, "slots numbered from 1 (left) to 4 (right)". The replacement section (printed p37) says three fan modules must be circulating air at all times and the fourth is redundant. If one fan fails the others go to 100%; if two fail the switch warns and powers down in 2 minutes (Overview note).

mgmt.mixed: the out-of-band block at the left end of the port side: an RJ-45 console port, an RJ-45 and an SFP management port and a USB port. Three media, one purpose: reaching the switch when the data plane cannot.

attrs.redundancy-note: installation guide, Overview: "Power supply modules (two-One for operations and one for redundancy [1+1])". Slot 1 is the top one and slot 2 the bottom one.

name: n9k-c9364d-gx2a

chassis-lamps.note: Appendix C: "The BCN, STS, and ENV, LEDs are located on the left side of the front of the switch." The figure draws three lamps in a row with a vertical legend under each, at 18.4, 23.1 and 27.5 mm across and 40.8 down. Above the management SFP cage the figure draws two small circles under printed text the resolution does not read; they are drawn as marks. The mark at the top left is the maker's logo; none is drawn. The model legend, NEXUS over N9K-C9364D-GX2A, is printed on the figure and is carried as text.

colour.note: NO SOURCE FOR THE COLOUR. The guide's figures are uncoloured line art. #d0d2cf is the value the 93180YC-EX's stencil sample gave, carried across as the family colour. Both guides' overview figures and the side figure were checked pixel by pixel and carry no colour at all. The only coloured picture of a family chassis held is the front figure of the Cisco N9364E-SG2-Q NX-OS Mode Switch Hardware Installation Guide, a rendering of another model: its plain left plate samples about #c8cac9. That is a cross-check and is not applied. The guide's text gives burgundy for the port-side intake fan and supply modules, which the modules carry.

gate-1.note: The front figure's outline is 1261 px across (x 5 to 1266) and 249 px down (y 104 to 353): aspect 5.06 against the guide's 17.41 x 3.45 in, 5.05, so 0.3% out, and it can be measured; 2.85 px per mm across and 2.84 down. THE FIGURE AGREES WITH 2 RU (one rack unit would be 10.1). The rear figure's outline is 1273 px across and 253 down, 5.03, 2.88 px per mm. The cage columns repeat at 67.6 px, 23.72 mm, from 167 px to 1181 px, so the pitch is the figure's and not the registry's.

port-lamps.note: Appendix C, Switch Chassis LEDs: "The port LEDs appear as triangles pointing up or down to the nearest port." Green is admin up, SFP present and link up; amber is admin down or SFP absent; off is up and present but no link. The figure draws four marks under each column of the LOWER group only: a boxed triangle at each end and two circles between them. The boxed triangles are drawn as the up and down lamps of the pair and the circles as marks. The upper group draws none.

port-order.note: The figure prints a pair of numbers over each column of the upper group, "1~2", "3~4" to "31~32", and under each column of the lower group a pair that reads "33~34" to "63~64" at this resolution (the first of the lower group reads like "35~36" and the rest of the lower group is not sharper, so the lower pair numbers are the sequence and not a reading). The guide's overview lists 64 QSFP-DD ports and its Table 1 reads "Ports 1-64" and "Odd numbered ports" against "Even numbered ports", so the upper cage of a pair is odd. Port numbers are as printed; the NX-OS interface names are not in the guide. The two SFP+ ports are numbered 65 and 66: the figure prints a number under each and the figure does not resolve them.

power.note: Appendix B, Switch Power Input Requirements: typical 1378 W and maximum 3000 W "(AC or DC)", 10,236.426 BTU per hour. The figures are the switch's draw and not a supply rating; the guide names no configuration or ambient. The same page carries a note, "If you want to use optics that consume 5W or more power on all the 36 ports , you must install 1100W power supplies", that cannot be this 64-port switch's (it names 36 ports and a supply this guide does not list) and is not carried.

rack-ears.note: The guide's Overview and its Clearance Requirements give no ear position: its rack-mount procedure for the NXK-ACC-KIT2-2RU installs two inner rails on the chassis sides and two outer rails on the posts, and slides the chassis in "until the front panel is flush with the front of the rack". The Clearance table calls the front clearance width "equal to the width of the chassis with two rack-mount brackets that are attached to it", 19.0 in, and no figure dimensions a bracket. So `chassis.ears` is left out and the gap says so.

rear-face.note: Every x and y on the rear is read off the rear figure (2.88 px per mm). Four fan modules at the left, "slots numbered from 1 (left) to 4 (right)", then two supplies stacked at the right, "slots numbered 1 (top) and 2 (bottom)", with a vertical MAC legend between the fans and the supplies. The figure shows AC supplies. The rear carries no port.

sources.note: One guide, held as PDF and as converted text and figures; it is not committed. Cisco N9364D-GX2A NX-OS Mode Switch Hardware Installation Guide, 72 pages, First Published 2022-06-24, Last Modified 2026-09-16: the Overview and its two flat figures (front art number 503684, rear 503685, both PDF page 8), appendix B specifications, appendix C LEDs, appendix D kits. PAGES ARE PDF PAGES with the printed page after them; THE PRINTED PAGE IS THE TABLE OF CONTENTS' NUMBER, and the converted set puts the dimension table on PDF page 60 against a printed 54, so PDF = printed + 6; no PDF renderer is installed on the host that did this work, so no PDF page was viewed and the text layer and the converted figures were read. NO DATA SHEET, PHOTOGRAPH, 3D MODEL OR STENCIL IS HELD for this model (the Nexus 9300-GX2 data sheet is on the intake's hand-off list and is not in the intake), and the NetBox devicetype-library is held as a path listing only: no file was read and nothing is taken from it. The figures are the guide's embedded bitmaps at about 2.85 pixels per mm and are low resolution; the 2-RU figure is flat and has callouts.

stack-orientation.note: Each column of each group is a stacked pair of QSFP-DD cages with a belly band between them, printed with a pair of numbers ("1~2"). The library's convention is the upper cage upright over the lower turned 180, as cisco/n9k-x9716d-gx@1 places its pairs; the figure is too coarse to show which way the contacts face, so the convention is taken.

the-x-axis.note: From the front figure, origin the left outline. The first cage opening starts at 56.8 mm and the sixteen columns step 23.72 mm; the last cage ends at 431.6 mm, 10.7 mm short of the right outline. The std/qsfp-dd@1 opening is 19.0 mm wide and the figure's reads about 19.9, so a column is the registry's cage centred on the figure's.

the-y-axis.note: From the same figure, origin the top outline. The upper group's stack runs 10.0 to 35.6 mm and the lower group's 50.2 to 76.5, so each stack is two 10 mm cages 15.8 mm apart (cisco/n9k-x9716d-gx@1 uses 14.85). A perforated band between the groups runs 36.3 to 49.6 mm and a row of small squares along the bottom edge.
